messages:
alex: Hey team — quick question on PR #5821, I'm seeing a CI failure from gofumpt in the format step. The change is just a tiny rename + proto regen. Can we either merge with an exemption or should I split out the generated file?

maria: can you paste the failing output?

alex: buildkite job 5821 -> gofumpt check fails on `proto/user.pb.go` wrap/line issue. log snippet:
```
run: gofumpt -w .
Diff found in proto/user.pb.go
exit status 1
```

sam: is that a generated file? we shouldn't commit regenerated .pb.go files unless proto actually changed. did you regenerate locally?

alex: I didn't touch the generation step deliberately — CI bumped gofumpt and it caught a formatting diff. Locally `gofumpt` also shows the diff. I can remove the generated file from the PR, keep the rename, and follow up with a regen commit.

kevin: if it's generated, strip it from the PR. commit message can say "exclude generated pb.go; regen follow-up". @jen we still need a 2nd approver for the rename itself.

jen: @alex please split the generated file out into its own commit (or remove it from the PR). once CI is clean i'll give a +1. :thumbsup:

alex: will do a force-push to remove generated file now.

ci-bot: buildkite:triggered job/5821 rerun (by alex)

maria: long-term we should pin gofumpt in CI so minor formatter bumps don't flip PRs. short-term, split + rerun and get this merged.

sam: agreed. short-term: split and merge. medium-term: add `make fmt-check` and pin the tool version.

alex: pushed the branch w/ generated file removed. rerunning: https://buildkite.com/redwood/job/5821/12345

ci-bot: buildkite job/5821 passed :party:

jen: left an approval. merging after the canary window. thanks for the quick split/response, @alex.

alex: thanks y'all :heart:
